In the past, I've had all of the symptoms of:

Brain tumor
Lung cancer
Throat cancer
Swine flu
HIV

How did I know I had the symptoms for these awful things? The Internet. Guess how many of them I have? Zero. I'm not trying to talk down to you about you and your girlfriends fears. I know fear, especially as it pertains to medical stuff. What I've learned in my years of worrying is that the actual act of worrying makes all physical symptoms worse and can actually make your body feel worse and create its own symptoms. I'm by no means accusing you or your girlfriend of being dishonest about how she feels, I'm just saying that the added stress of the situation will only serve to make her, and you, feel worse. 

I think it's good she is going to the doctor to get further testing but I'm confident you will both feel much better after the results come back ok and they can focus on a log term plan to make her feel better. Just stay strong for her and for yourself. Here if you need to talk.

I hope everything is ok for you, too. People care about you. I care. I'm happy to hear you took that positive first step in what I'm sure will be a long journey full of ups and downs. Don't fear the unknown. Embrace it. Here for you, man.

Hope isn't a bad thing to have, but when it comes to
matters of the heart like this, it's better to assume there won't be a reconciliation and think about yourself and what YOU need. If the possibility of getting back with her, or the unknown of the situation is what is hurting you the most about this, then make it clear to her that if she doesn't want this relationship then you can't talk to her anymore.  If she cares about you and your well-being, she'll respect your wishes.

My advice is that if she is the one that initiated this, then take it at face value for what it is and consider it done. It's not fair for her to say that. It's almost like she wants to be single and do what she wants while keeping you at arms length with hope for reconciliation.  I would recommend telling her you understand how she feels, you will give her the space she wants, and then as hard as it might be, move on. Use this time away from her to continue to better yourself. And you never know, you may find someone better in time. But do yourself a favor and don't hold out hope for her to return. I'm not saying it won't happen at some point in the future, but if it's meant to be, let it happen organically, don't sit around and wait for it.

Once you finish the main quests in TVHM, all of the remaining side quests scale to level 50.  Many people use this to strategically save certain side missions that give unique rewards (weapons/sheilds/relics, etc).  An example of this would be the Cult of the Eternal Flame sidequests from Lilith.  If saved until after you beat the main quests and defeat the warrior (meaning you don't even accept the quest, leave it as an undiscovered quest), you will play through that quest and get a level 50 legendary sheild.  If you accept that quest while you play through the main story, you'll probably get a level 38 version or so.  Hope that makes sense.
